title: 第3章 阴阳神魔鉴
slug: 掠天记全本免费-掠天记最新章节列表
content_zh:
正值晌午时分，阳光最烈的时候，方行翘着二郎腿坐在草棚里的凉椅之上，远远的，王志等人正在药田里忙碌，有些灵药需要在中朵阳光最烈的时候除虫，因为在阳光最烈的时候，它的花朵才会自动张开，也只有这个时候，才能将寄生在它花蕊里的虫子捉出来。
丙三号灵田的方行老大自然是不用干这些粗活的，自从那夜一刀捅了王志之后，方行便已经成了这丙三号灵田的大爷了，就连每天的臭袜子都有人洗好了晾干净。
王志不是没想过报复，在第二天，他就目光不善的看着方行。
而方行只是笑嘻嘻的，又是一刀捅在了他大腿上，从那时起，王志就彻底服了。
强的怕狠的啊！
王志虽然号称丙三号灵田的老大，但也只是欺负欺负身边这些小道童而已，何时真与人动过刀子？须知道，他虽是道童，也是三代良善，才被选进来的。
往祖上数三代，都找不着一个比方行更狠的，他就更不用说了。
至于其他人，在那个晚上便彻底服了，小雀斑现在见了方行还哆嗦。
闲坐了一会也是无趣，方行便又一次打起精神翻看那本青云锻气篇，只是过了一会，又摇着头合上了，没用，他已经试过了，按照青云锻气篇上所说的修炼方法，自己根本感觉不到所谓的灵气什么的，连试了三回之后，方行便认定这里面是胡说八道了。
也不光是他，丙字三号灵田里的这些人就没个能感应到灵气存在的，就连王志，所谓的感应到了气感之类，也只是为了往自己脸上贴金，方行早就逼出真话来了。
不过，这本经书方行还是没舍得扔掉，毕竟听王志他们说，一万道童里面，还是有人凭这本经书修炼成了书上所说的灵气的，而且凭此成为了青云山的外门弟子。
这样的人不多，但每年都会有一两天这样的传闻，应该不是假的。
“大概老子不是修行的料吧……”
方行无奈的摇了摇头，心想道门重资质，这也不是没道理的，资质确实重要。
放弃了再研究青云锻气篇的打算，方行又取出了自己包袱里的那本紫皮薄册子，这小册子是他的九叔给他的，为鬼烟谷引来了灭谷之祸的也是此书，就在那一个晚上，肖剑鸣脚踏一只铁鹰，从天而降，驾驭一柄幽寒飞剑，将鬼烟谷上下三百悍匪杀的干干净净。
惟一逃掉的，就是自己这个小悍匪。
肖剑鸣一直以为逃掉的第十个匪首乃是一个和其他人一样的壮汉，大概没想到自己只是一个十岁的孩子吧……
也正是因为自己是个孩子，在其他人决意死战的时候，九叔将这本书交给了自己，让自己好好保管，然后将自己扔进了密道。方行毫不犹豫就逃了，逃得飞快，他知道自己绝不是那个站在铁鹰背上的冷厉男子对手，甚至连他脚下的铁鹰都可以一爪子抓死自己……
紫皮薄册子封皮上写着五个古篆字，方行倒是跟九叔学过古篆字，识得上面写着的是五个大字：阴阳神魔鉴。
然而他确信这不是一本空白的书，不然鬼烟谷不会遭此大祸。

“难道是用什么药水写上的，就像二叔搞的那些骗肥羊的藏宝图一样？”
方行琢磨了一下，又感觉不太像。
那种药水都是有时间限制的，而这本书明显非常久远，这种古老的痕迹是骗不了人的。
这样想着，方行便将这本书放在了正摊在他膝盖上的青云锻气篇上，抬头轻叹，感觉自己还是任重道远啊，几乎没有丝毫复仇的希望，不过也就在这时，他微一低头，忽然惊愕的发现这本阴阳神魔鉴上竟然出现了一行淡淡的字迹，宛若凭空显化。
“青云锻气篇，凝气境修行法诀，炼精化气，可成神通……”
“见鬼了……”
方行猛然坐直了身体，呆呆的看着书上的几行字。
此时的空白书页上，显化的正是对于青云锻气篇上的介绍，不算详细，却寥寥数语，将青云锻气篇的用途，原理，甚至连这本经修行经诀的不足之处都指了出来……
呆了半晌，方行将阴阳神魔鉴这本书抬了起来，果然，字迹很快消失了。
又将它放了下去，与青云锻气篇接触，字迹便又显现了出来。
方行一阵激动，忙四下里打量，一琢磨，将旁边自己吃了半个的西瓜放在了书上。

content_en:
It was noon, when the sun was at its strongest, and Fang Xing was sitting on an outdoor chair in the thatched shed with his legs crossed. In the distance, Wang Zhi and others were busy in the medicine field. Some elixirs needed to be dewormed when the sun was at their strongest, because the flowers would open automatically when the sun was at their strongest, and only at this time could the insects parasitizing in their stamens be caught.
Fang Xing, the boss of No. Bing3 Lingtian, naturally doesn't have to do such rough work. Ever since he stabbed Wang Zhi that night, Fang Xing has become the boss of No.Bing3 Lingtian. Even the smelly socks are washed and dried every day.
It's not that Wang Zhi didn't think about revenge. The next day, he looked at Fang Xing with an unkind look.
But Fang Xing just smiled and stabbed him in the thigh again. From then on, Wang Zhi was completely convinced.
The strong ones are afraid of the ruthless ones!
Although Wang Zhi is known as the boss of No. 3 Lingtian, he only bullies the little Taoist boys around him. When has he ever actually had a knife with someone? You must know that although he is a Taoist boy, he was selected because of his good deeds from three generations.
Counting three generations of ancestors, there is no one more ruthless than Fang Xing, let alone him.
As for the others, they were completely convinced that night. Little Freckles was still trembling when he saw Fang Xing.
After sitting around for a while, it was boring. Fang Xing cheered up and flipped through the Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter again. After a while, he shook his head and closed it again. It was useless. He had already tried it. According to the training methods mentioned in the Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter, he couldn't feel the so-called spiritual energy at all. After trying it three times in a row, Fang Xing decided that it was nonsense.
Not only him, but none of the people in the No. 3 C Spiritual Field could sense the existence of spiritual energy. Even Wang Zhi's so-called sensing of spiritual energy was just to put gold on his own face. Fang Xing had already forced the truth out.
However, Fang Xing was still unwilling to throw away this sutra. After all, Wang Zhi and others said that among the ten thousand Taoists, there were still some who cultivated the spiritual energy mentioned in the book based on this sutra, and became outer disciples of Qingyun Mountain.
There are not many people like this, but there are rumors like this for one or two days every year, and they should not be false.
"Maybe I'm not a spiritual practitioner..."
Fang Xing shook his head helplessly, thinking that it was not unreasonable for Taoists to value qualifications. Qualifications are indeed important.
Giving up on studying the Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter, Fang Xing took out the thin purple-covered booklet in his bag. This booklet was given to him by his ninth uncle. It was also the book that caused the disaster of the Ghost Smoke Valley. On that night, Xiao Jianming stepped on an iron eagle, descended from the sky, controlled a cold flying sword, and killed three hundred fierce bandits in the Ghost Smoke Valley.
The only one who escaped was this little gangster himself.
Xiao Jianming always thought that the tenth bandit leader who escaped was a strong man like the others. He probably didn't expect that he was just a ten-year-old child...
It was precisely because he was a child that when others were determined to fight to the death, Uncle Jiu handed the book to him, told him to keep it well, and then threw himself into the secret passage. Fang Xing ran away without hesitation. He ran away very fast. He knew that he was no match for the cold and stern man standing on the back of the iron eagle. Even the iron eagle under his feet could catch him to death with one claw...
There were five ancient seal characters written on the cover of the thin purple booklet. Fang Xing had learned ancient seal characters from Uncle Jiu, so he recognized the five characters written on it: Yin Yang God and Demon Mirror.
However, he was sure that this was not a blank book, otherwise Ghost Smoke Valley would not have suffered such a disaster.
"Could it be written with some kind of potion, just like those treasure maps that my uncle made to deceive fat sheep?"
Fang Xing thought about it for a while, but it didn't feel like it.
Those kinds of potions are time-limited, and this book is obviously very old. Such ancient traces cannot deceive people.
With this thought in mind, Fang Xing put this book awayStanding on the Qingyun Forging Chapter that was lying on his knees, he raised his head and sighed, feeling that he still had a long way to go, and there was almost no hope of revenge. However, at this moment, he lowered his head slightly, and was suddenly shocked to find that a line of faint writing appeared on the book of Yin Yang Gods and Demons, as if it appeared out of thin air.
"Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter, practice the magic formula in the Qi Condensation Realm, refine the Qi, and become a magical power..."
"What the hell..."
Fang Xing suddenly sat upright and stared blankly at a few lines of words in the book.
What appeared on the blank page at this time was the introduction to the Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter. It was not detailed, but in just a few words, it pointed out the uses, principles, and even the shortcomings of the Qingyun Qi Forging Chapter...
After being stunned for a long time, Fang Xing lifted up the book Yin-Yang Gods and Demons. Sure enough, the writing quickly disappeared.
He put it down again, and when it came into contact with the Qingyun Forging Qi Pian, the writing appeared again.
Fang Xing felt excited and looked around hurriedly. After thinking about it, he placed the half-eaten watermelon next to him on the book.
